referenceNotes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: this station's config previously (incorrectly) listed it as UNDERGROUND. Public sources are consistent that the built Purple Line station is ELEVATED, with side platforms, opened 20 October 2011, constructed by Punj Lloyd. That has been corrected in stationConfigs.ts/metadata.json alongside adding this file.

Supported by sources: elevated, side platforms toward Whitefield/Challaghatta, beside Cubbon Park, a bicycle stand near the Urban Square entrance. A separate underground Pink Line platform pair is under construction beneath the existing station (targeted ~Dec 2026 per sources), but does not exist yet and is not modelled.

NOT supported, and not claimed as accurate: exact entrance count/positions, canopy/roof form, or material and colour detail — sources describe facilities and history, not architectural appearance. entranceCount is set to a conservative default (2), not a verified figure.
Renderer limitation, disclosed rather than hidden: the real side-platform arrangement is approximated as a single island module, same as every other elevated station in this dataset.
No image files were downloaded, scraped, or embedded — this dataset stores link-only pointers to publicly viewable pages, gathered by reading their text content.
